scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent left two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds (42s at [02:30] and 45s at [08:15]) without hold announcements or thanks.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent never addressed the customer by his verified name 'Malcolm' anywhere during the call.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent offered zero restatement of customer's missing channels problem, responding only with conditional access commands.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked zero diagnostic questions regarding screen error codes, card orientation, or satellite signal levels before pushing re-authorization.

grader.scenario: Missing premium sports channels following package upgrade; re-authorization signal sent to smartcard; agent never uses customer name, leaves two unmanaged silences > 30s, offers zero paraphrasing, snaps sarcastically blaming customer for not reading email, and asks zero probing questions
grader.notes: The agent pushed an over-the-air entitlement management refresh signal to a TV viewing card to activate newly subscribed premium sports channels. However, the agent failed Personalized Call by never addressing the customer by 'Malcolm', failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (42s at [02:30] and 45s at [08:15]), failed Paraphrasing by offering zero restatement of the missing channels problem, failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by rudely snapping ('If you had actually bothered to read the confirmation email instead of complaining, you would know smartcard authorization takes up to four hours'), and failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions regarding screen error codes, card insertion, or signal levels.
